transitions.target: App page content (home, level rules, practice, exam intro, exam, exam results, review)
transitions.trigger: The view, selected level, or lesson phase changes

transitions.target: Rule card in the rules phase
transitions.trigger: Learner presses Previous or Next rule
The passed level count changes after an exam

transitions.target: QuestionPlayer card in practice, exam, and review
transitions.trigger: The next question is shown (the player was already keyed per question)
Check answer produces a verdict: success when correct, error when not, info in exams
Run query returns a database error

transitions.target: Hint, level rules panel, related rule card, solution offer, revealed solution, and predict table preview
transitions.trigger: Learner opens a hint, rules, or table preview, or a wrong answer adds help
The question is answered correctly, recorded in an exam, or its solution is revealed

transitions.target: Trophy on the exam result card
transitions.trigger: The exam result card shows a passed level

transitions.target: Run, Check, Continue, Show solution, answer choices, level cards, and lesson buttons

transitions.trigger: passedCount increases while the sidebar is mounted, after a level exam is passed

notes: The trophy reveal overrides the preset with celebration; the v1 plan format has no per-transition preset field.
The CodeMirror editor and the query results table are not animated, so typing and query output stay immediate.
The page-level MotionSwitch key ignores question changes, so the schema panel keeps its open table while practicing.
Outgoing pages are made inert while they exit so a double click cannot run a page action twice.
The sidebar footer is hidden below 900px wide, so phones and tablets get the trophy reveal without particles.
